```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent "Entity value">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT extra (#PCDATA)>">
  %param;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.org/ns2">
  <!-- Initial root comment -->
  <ns2:child>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags> &ent; references
    ]]>
  </ns2:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book)*>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY author "John Doe">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!ENTITY % external_decl SYSTEM "decl.dtd">
  %external_decl;
]>
<?pi-target data="processing instruction content"?>
<catalog xmlns="urn:catalog:ns" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xlink:type="extended">
  <!-- Catalog top-level comment with special characters <>&"' -->
  <book xlink:type="locator" xlink:href="http://example.org">
    <![CDATA[
      <book-details>
        <author>&author;</author>
      </book-details>
    ]]>
  </book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % custom_attr "id ID #REQUIRED">
  <!ENTITY testEnt "Test & Entity">
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.org/inventory" xmlns:local="http://example.org/local">
  <!-- Comment in inventory element -->
  <local:item id="i1">
    <![CDATA[
      Item data with raw content & testEnt inside CDATA.
    ]]>
  </local:item>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseText">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base; Extended">
]>
<?xml-debug level="verbose" mode="test"?>
<document xmlns="http://example.com/doc" xmlns:m="http://example.com/meta">
  <!-- Section comment block -->
  <m:section>
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text block with entities like &derived;
    ]]>
  </m:section>
  <section>&derived;</section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ref "ReferenceValue">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "readme.txt" NDATA txt>
  <!ENTITY % internal_macro "<!ENTITY macroEnt 'Expanded Macro'>">
  %internal_macro;
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="data" data="value='true'"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:atom="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom">
  <!-- Archive metadata comment -->
  <atom:record>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing markup <record>¯oEnt;</record>
    ]]>
  </atom:record>
  <record>&ref;</record>
</archive>
